description: This file contains a Java class MacroCallParameterMapValueMatcher, a custom matcher for testing purposes that operates on Map objects with String keys and values. It is part of a testing suite within the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.renderer.macro package.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterMapValueMatcher
classes.description: A custom Hamcrest matcher that verifies the values within a Map<String, String> using an underlying Matcher. It facilitates assertions in unit tests related to maps containing macro call parameters.

methods.name: MacroCallParameterMapValueMatcher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matcher with a specific Matcher for Map<String, String> objects.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Overrides the method to perform the actual matching logic using the provided matcher.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Provides a textual description of what the matcher checks.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Provides detailed description for mismatch during tests to aid debugging.
